questions.q: What does the Toolbox panel in Flow Builder list?
options: The elements and resources you've built in the current flow, plus New Resource
A list of all other flows in the org
The org's full list of custom objects
A history of every user who has logged into Setup
questions.explain: The Toolbox lists the current flow's elements and resources and has the New Resource button.

questions.q: A teammate edits a flow, clicks Run without saving first, and sees no change. What's the explanation?
options: Run reloads the App Launcher before executing
Run executes the most recently saved version — unsaved changes aren't included
Run only works after the flow is activated
Run requires Debug to be clicked first
questions.explain: Run runs the most recently saved version of the flow; any unsaved changes are not included in that run.

questions.q: Which part of the Flow Builder screen is the working area where elements are added and connected into a visual diagram?
options: The button bar
The App Launcher
The canvas
The Setup menu
questions.explain: The canvas is the central working area; adding elements to it creates a visual diagram of the flow.

questions.q: What does Debug let you do that Run does not?
options: Activate a new version automatically
Edit the flow's API name
Delete old versions of the flow
Feed the flow sample data and review what it does at each step before anyone else touches it
questions.explain: Debug runs the flow's last saved version against sample data you choose, letting you verify behavior before activating.

questions.q: Which canvas layout style does this lesson say Salesforce recommends, and that this course uses throughout?
options: Classic Layout
Manual Grid
Free-Form
Auto-Layout
questions.explain: Auto-Layout arranges and connects elements automatically and unlocks extra features like path highlighting.
